limitations: Specific to three rows/strength three and diagonal translation symmetry. The asymptotic exponent applies only to this developed subclass. The PHF(3;1620,81,3) corollary is not claimed as a current global record because historical online PHF tables were not accessible. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
provenance: Exact equivalence between diagonally translation-developed three-row perfect hash families and tri-colored sum-free sets in finite abelian groups, with asymptotic and finite-field consequences.
record_title: Tri-colored sum-free sets characterize group-developed three-row perfect hash families
